 VAIM has signed an exclusive distribution agreement with Cartessa Aesthetics to introduce its professional-use cosmetic, JuveLook Skincare Serum, to clinics and medical spas in the United States.
 Under the agreement, Cartessa will handle U.S. sales and distribution, while VAIM’s U.S. subsidiary will provide product training and technical support.
 Based in Melville, N.Y., Cartessa supplies aesthetic devices, including lasers and radiofrequency (RF) microneedling systems, to U.S. healthcare providers and med spas.
 VAIM’s JuveLook Skincare Serum (Courtesy of VAIM) 
 The partnership will expand JuveLook Skincare’s distribution beyond its primarily online channels to dermatology clinics, other medical practices and med spas. VAIM plans to begin supplying the serum to U.S. practices this month and gradually expand distribution.
 The topical serum is designed for skin care after aesthetic procedures such as RF microneedling and laser treatments, in accordance with applicable U.S. regulations and product instructions. VAIM developed it using research and technology associated with its JuveLook brand.
 VAIM introduced the serum to about 400 healthcare professionals and industry representatives at Cartessa’s Inner Circle event in Miami, Fla., in October.
 “Cartessa’s nationwide distribution network and the training and technical support from our U.S. subsidiary will help us strengthen relationships with local partners and build the brand’s presence in the U.S. professional market,” a VAIM official said.
